summary: Apple's framework for host-side GPU acceleration of a macOS guest in a virtual machine (Mac Catalyst 14.0, macOS 11.0). BifrOSt is a Linux desktop that runs on bare metal and has no virtual-machine host API, so there is no counterpart.

features.note: Apple-only VM graphics stack for macOS guests

features.feature: PCI device identity for the guest
features.note: advertises a virtual PCI device to a guest; BifrOSt does not host guests
display mode reporting to a hypervisor host
option ROM for the virtual GPU
pixel coordinate type for the display API only
